0022600123.text: The Pacers (2-1) visit the Bucks (0-3) with Indiana 2nd in the Central, one game back, and 5th in the East, while Milwaukee sits 5th in the Central, three games back, and 13th in the East. Indiana is 2-0 on the road and 0-1 at home, and it has won its most recent game after going 2-1 over its last three, while Milwaukee has lost three straight. Ben Sheppard, Johnny Furphy and T.J. McConnell are all out for the Pacers, and Ivica Zubac is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and Indiana lost all four meetings to Milwaukee in 2025-26, including a 134-123 loss in Milwaukee on March 15, 2026.
